claims.text: The FBI's own position on the 22 March 1950 Guy Hottel memo, the most-viewed document in its Vault: it 'does not prove the existence of UFOs; it is simply a second- or third-hand claim that we never investigated. Some people believe the memo repeats a hoax that was circulating at that time, but the Bureau's files have no information to verify that theory.'

edges.label: Air Force denials of Hangar 18 bodies
edges.note: Robert Spencer Carr's 1974 public claim that bodies recovered near Aztec were held at 'Hangar 18' at Wright-Patterson AFB drew official Air Force denials. The FBI separately disowned the Guy Hottel memo, the one federal document ever cited as corroboration, in a published 2013 statement.
